briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with major model releases from OpenAI and Google. Funding surges past $11B this quarter as nations accelerate sovereign AI programs. Multi-agent systems now dominate deployment discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration while Anthropic releases Claude 4.5 Opus. Google DeepMind counters with Gemini 3 Ultra. Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B. DeepSeek R2 achieves parity on key benchmarks at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early pilots in automotive and IoT showing 99.7% attack mitigation.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly. Microsoft announces $40B hyperscale buildout in Texas. TSMC begins 2nm production dedicated to AI ASICs. Energy constraints now limit 30% of planned clusters.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
